subject: Your thesis at 2AM
preview_text: The one mistake that makes professors doubt you and how to fix it in minutes.
body_paragraphs: It's 2AM. You're staring at a blinking cursor, desperate to finish that thesis. I've seen this a thousand times. The number one mistake most students make isn't bad research or weak arguments. It's thinking your first draft is good enough to submit.

You spend hours polishing grammar, but the real problem is your thesis statement. If it's vague, professors flag it. If it's too complex, AI detectors catch it. That's why 50,000 students use Thesis Generator to cut the fluff and nail a statement that's clear, original, and human-sounding.

Here's the easy fix: open the app and run your thesis through the 'Humanize AI text' feature. It rewords your draft to bypass Turnitin and GPTZero while keeping your voice. Plus, you can export a polished PDF ready to submit in under 10 minutes.

Open Thesis Generator now and paste your current thesis in the 'Humanize' tab. It's already on your phone. P.S. This same fix turned a C+ paper into an A- for one user last week. Don't let yours be the one that slips.
